notes: «وكان، محمد بن جبير ذكر لي ذكرا من حديثه ذلك» names a man who told the compiler of the hadith in an aside; he is not written as a link, and whether he is one needs ruling (rule 6)
«فانطلقت ... فسألته ... فقال مالك» is the compiler asking Malik ibn Aws, who is already the last link
«وكان، محمد بن جبير ذكر لي ذكرا من حديثه ذلك» names a man who told the compiler of the hadith in an aside; he is not written as a link, and whether he is one needs ruling (rule 6)
«فانطلقت ... فسألته ... فقال مالك» is the compiler asking Malik ibn Aws, who is already the last link
«وكان، محمد بن جبير ذكر لي ذكرا من حديثه ذلك»: Muhammad ibn Jubayr either told Ibn Shihab the story (a link) or appears only in the scene; not added, and the text does not settle it (rule 6)
the last link is Malik ibn Aws, whose first-person words (فقال مالك بينا أنا جالس) are the saying; Umar, Ali and Abbas inside the story are not chain links
